_scriptVersion: The Park Dial voice script, English recording, 2026-10-09, 26 lines

_voiceLines._text: I come to the pond every evening to feed my ducks. I hope it stays just like this.

_voiceLines._trigger: Drones keep away from the pond
_voiceLines._text: Quiet again. Just me and the ducks.
That lamp's still out. I'll have to walk home in the dark again.
There they are. Same as always.
Even more of them this year. This is what a park is for.
Smell those flowers. The bees found the garden too.
A few drones, a few ducks. I suppose we can share.
What's that buzzing? You're scaring them off.
Where did my ducks go?
Those towers are pretty at night, I'll admit. But I miss the water.

_voiceLines._trigger: Five years on, pond is gone
_voiceLines._text: I still come out of habit. All that buzzing, who asked for this?
That lamp post by the path has been dark for a week. I'm waiting on a part.

_voiceLines._trigger: Part is still on its way
_voiceLines._text: Still waiting on that part. Taking the scenic route, apparently.
About time. Lamp's fixed.
Deliveries are slow, but the park looks after itself. Less work for me.

_voiceLines._trigger: Part arrives after a few days
_voiceLines._text: Took a few days. Can't complain.
That was fast. Lamp's fixed.
Pads, towers, lights. A lot more to maintain now. Keeps me busy.
I walk her here every day. Honestly, this park could use a bit of an upgrade.
Nice and calm today, I'll give it that.
My orders take ages out here. Nothing ever changes in this park.
Okay, the garden is kind of nice. Still waiting on my package though.
Not bad. Could be faster, but not bad.
Mine came in minutes. That's how it should be.

_voiceLines._trigger: Five years on, towers light up
_voiceLines._text: Look at that skyline. This place finally feels like the future.

_voiceLines._trigger: Five years on, pond is gone
_voiceLines._text: She doesn't chase the ducks anymore. There aren't any left.
